title: Xila developer key (experimental v1)
description: A developer (publisher) key file, keys/developers/<id>.json in xila-project/registry. The key signs package manifests; it is not a trust anchor. It may publish an identifier when the namespace file covering it (namespaces/<namespace>.json) lists this key, and only packages whose kind is in kinds (Wasm only when kinds is absent).

$schema.description: Optional editor-facing schema URL; not a trust anchor.

id.description: Identifier referenced by registry entries (publisher); must equal the file name.

public_key.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key in canonical base64.

openssh.description: The same key in OpenSSH form; informational only.

namespaces.description: Legacy grant, until the migration of Xila's own packages: ["xila"] lets this key publish the two-component xila.<name> identifiers. No other namespace may be listed here; reverse-DNS namespaces are granted by namespace files, so adding a developer never changes a key file.

kinds.description: Package kinds this key may publish. Absent or null means wasm only: native code on a microcontroller without a memory protection unit runs fully trusted, so a key needs an explicit native grant. A target starting with wasm32- or wasm64- is wasm; every other target is native.
